title: United States Peril Codes (v2.9)
text:
United States Peril Codes (v2.9)
 

Peril codes for the United States supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
| PFO | Fire only |
| PWF | Wind and Fire |
| PWS | Windstorm only |
| PTR | Terrorism |
| PMPCI | Multi-Peril Crop Insurance |
| PAN | Pandemic |
| PCH | Crop Hail |
| PFL | Flood |

Note:

Just as wind and earthquake exposures need to be entered as separate records in
 
UNICEDE
/2 files, Terrorism and Pandemic
 exposures should also be entered as a separate record.

Use 
W
 as the coverage for the Pandemic peril.
